ticker_news.title: What Are 2 Great Tech Stocks to Buy Right Now?
ticker_news.description: The article highlights Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) and Symbotic as promising tech stocks, driven by their potential in AI infrastructure and warehouse automation. AMD is gaining market share in chipmaking and has a strong partnership with OpenAI, while Symbotic offers AI-powered robotics for warehouse efficiency.
ticker_news.author: Patrick Sanders

QQQ.title: Forget Wall Street Jargon: This 3-Step Plan Could Turn First-Time Investors Into Lifelong Winners
QQQ.description: A simple 3-step investment strategy for beginners: build a savings cushion, invest in low-cost index funds and ETFs, and maintain consistent, disciplined investing over time to leverage compound growth.
QQQ.author: Adam Spatacco
